text:
Cassie Moreno: Hey folks! Cassie here — joining Product Ops from NYC. I bring a (modest) drum kit, a turtle named Pickle, and an extremely opinionated beanbag. Excited to meet you all :tada:
Mira Patel: welcome Cassie!! where's Pickle's passport? :turtle: :wave:
Noah Park: hi Cassie, turtle pics pls 🙏 also coffee or tea?
Ryan K.: :wave: welcome! Coffee or tea check-in matters. also love that you play drums. any fav artists?
Cassie Moreno: Coffee, black. favs: Tom Tom Club → modern beats, and I mess around with jazz brushes. Pickle is still on a US-only diet (no passport needed) — pic attached later :camera_with_flash:
Abby Lin: welcome!! if you ever want to crash a rooftop jam session, count me in. also we have a beanbag corner in the 3rd floor lounge labeled 'ambiguous seating' :)
Mira Patel: omg the 'ambiguous seating' sign is real. also FYI there's a casual lunch meetup Wed 12:30 near the bikes if you wanna join — lots of new hires go.
Noah Park: quick poll (Cassie run this): best pizza near the office? 1) Tony's 2) Rosa's 3) DoughLab — reply with the number.
Cassie Moreno: 3 — DoughLab for the rectangular life.
Ryan K.: 2 :+1:
Abby Lin: 3 :pizza:
Mira Patel: 1 if you're a pepperoni maximalist :drooling_face:
Noah Park: results: tie between 2 and 3. we'll have to do a taste test :smile: welcome again, Cassie!
welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Cassie! We've added you to the #product-oncall and #lunch-roulette channels. If you need an access badge or laptop adapter, DM @People Ops.
